user.title: Connect to your GivEnergy inverter
user.description: Choose the inverter's WiFi/LAN dongle from the ones found on your network, or type its IP address. Give it a fixed IP address in your router, or let Home Assistant follow it if it changes (it does for dongles it discovers).

data_description.host: The IP address of the inverter's dongle.
data_description.port: The dongle's Modbus TCP port, normally 8899.
data_description.entity_prefix: Entity IDs start with this, then the serial number, as GivTCP's do (eg. sensor.givtcp_sa1234g567_soc). Keep the prefix you used in GivTCP so your dashboards, automations and Predbat keep working.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up a discovered GivEnergy inverter

data_description.entity_prefix: Entity IDs start with this, then the serial number, as GivTCP's do (eg. sensor.givtcp_sa1234g567_soc). Keep the prefix you used in GivTCP so your dashboards, automations and Predbat keep working.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect to the inverter. Check the IP address, that the dongle is on your network, and that nothing else is blocking port 8899.
error.unsupported: This inverter isn't supported yet ({reason}). Single-phase hybrids, AC-coupled and All-in-One inverters are; keep using the GivTCP add-on for the others for now.

abort.already_configured: This inverter is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The inverter's address has been updated.
abort.wrong_inverter: That address is a different inverter. Add it as a new one instead.
abort.not_givenergy: That device isn't a GivEnergy inverter.
abort.unsupported: This inverter isn't supported yet ({reason}). Single-phase hybrids, AC-coupled and All-in-One inverters are; keep using the GivTCP add-on for the others for now.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the live values (power, energy, battery).
data_description.full_refresh_interval: How often to read the inverter's settings (mode, slots, rates). They're also read straight after every change.

no_inverter.message: No GivTCP inverter is set up and running.

which_inverter.message: More than one GivTCP inverter is set up: choose which one.

force_charge.name: Force charge
force_charge.description: Charge the battery from the grid at full rate to 100% for a while, through charge slot 1, then put the settings back.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter

force_export.name: Force export
force_export.description: Discharge the battery to the grid at full power for a while, through discharge slot 1, then put the settings back.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: Which inverter, if you have more than one.

pause_charge.name: Pause charge
pause_charge.description: Stop the battery charging for a while, by setting the charge rate to 0, then put the rate back.

pause_discharge.name: Pause discharge
pause_discharge.description: Stop the battery discharging for a while, by setting the discharge rate to 0, then put the rate back.

config_entry_id.name: Inverter
config_entry_id.description: Which inverter, if you have more than one.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: End a force charge, force export or pause now, and put the settings back.
